nodes.description: MARVEL constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints full supply to msg.sender.
totalSupply() view: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view: returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and decrements allowance via safeSub/safeAdd.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b; require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b.
string public name = 'MARVEL INU'.
string public symbol = 'MINU'.
uint8 public decimals = 18.
uint256 public _totalSupply = 1000000000000000000000000.
mapping(address => uint) balances: core ledger of token holdings.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowance ledger.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner and mint recipient.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) in transfer: arithmetic balance debit.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer: arithmetic balance credit.
balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) in transferFrom: arithmetic debit of arbitrary 'from'.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) in transferFrom: allowance arithmetic decrement.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transferFrom: arithmetic credit.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens in approve: unrestricted allowance overwrite (access control surface).
_totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(): unchecked unsigned subtraction (reverts instead of wrapping only in 0.8+, here silent underflow risk).
parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf/allowance: address whose data is read.
parameter spender of approve/allowance: address granted/queried allowance.
parameter tokens: user-supplied amount moved in approve/transfer/transferFrom.
parameter to: destination address of transfer/transferFrom.
parameter from: source address of transferFrom, debit target of balances/allowed.
local c: result variable of SafeMath helpers.
local balance: named return of balanceOf.
local remaining: named return of allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the balances mapping that is debited by the unchecked-arithmetic helper call in transfer.
transfer credit path executes under the identity of msg.sender.
transferFrom debit path is authorized only by msg.sender through the allowance ledger.
msg.sender is the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender] decremented by safeSub.
msg.sender owns the allowed[msg.sender][spender] slot written by approve, so any caller can set arbitrary allowances.
msg.sender is used as the owner key of the balances mapping.
msg.sender is used as the owner/spender key of the allowed mapping.
transfer() execution path performs the safeSub balance debit first.
transfer() execution path performs the safeAdd balance credit.
transferFrom() first executes the safeSub debit of balances[from].
transferFrom() then decrements the spender allowance via safeSub.
transferFrom() finally credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
approve() unconditionally writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without any validation of spender.
totalSupply() computes the unchecked subtraction at runtime.
constructor assigns the full fixed supply literal to _totalSupply.
constructor mints the entire supply into balances[msg.sender].
transfer() delegates its debit computation to safeSub.
transfer() delegates its credit computation to safeAdd.
transferFrom() delegates both debit and allowance updates to safeSub.
transferFrom() delegates the final credit to safeAdd.
safeSub result is written back into balances[msg.sender].
safeAdd result is written into balances[to].
safeSub result is written into balances[from].
safeSub result is written into allowed[from][msg.sender].
safeAdd result is written into balances[to] in transferFrom.
approve() stores the new allowance into the allowed mapping.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is subtracted without a safe-math guard, enabling underflow semantics.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key of balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter is the owner key of allowance.
spender parameter is the spender key of allowance.
spender parameter becomes the key written by approve.
tokens parameter is written directly as the allowance value, unbounded.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the transfer debit.
tokens parameter is the addend of the transfer credit.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the transferFrom balance debit.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the allowance decrement.
tokens parameter is the addend of the transferFrom credit.
to parameter indexes the credited balance in transfer.
to parameter indexes the credited balance in transferFrom.
from parameter selects an arbitrary account to debit with no check that msg.sender owns it; only the allowance of msg.sender is consumed.
from parameter is the outer key of allowed[from][msg.sender] being decremented.
local c carries the safeAdd result.
local c carries the safeSub result.
local c carries the safeMul result.
local c carries the safeDiv result.
local balance is the named return of balanceOf.
local remaining is the named return of allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is only a plain argument of balanceOf/allowance; it should be folded into the balanceOf function node rather than modeled as a standalone node.
spender is only used to index the allowance mapping in approve; merge into the approve function node.
tokens is the amount flowing through transfer's safeSub/safeAdd operations; merge into the transfer function node.
to is merely the destination key of the transfer credit; merge into the transfer function node.
from is the source key of the transferFrom debit; merge into the transferFrom function node.
local c is the return slot of the SafeMath helpers; merge into safeAdd as the representative arithmetic core node.
local balance is a synthetic named return with no independent semantics; merge into balanceOf.
local remaining is a synthetic named return with no independent semantics; merge into allowance.
